description: Send feedback to the team that builds Time of Meeting. Use it when one of our tools fails, gives a wrong result, or can’t do what the user needs. Describe the problem, not the user: leave out names, email addresses and other personal details.

problem.description: The error, the wrong result, or the feature you needed but couldn’t find.
problem.title: What went wrong or is missing

proposed_fix.description: What would have worked, such as a new tool, an extra field, a clearer error, or a different result.
proposed_fix.title: Proposed fix

tool_name.description: The tool or action you called. Leave it empty if none fit.
tool_name.title: Tool name (optional)

tried.description: The task you were working on and the call you made, including the inputs that matter. Don’t include personal details.
tried.title: What you tried

name: submit_feedback

alternatives.description: Other cities that matched the same name, after the best-ranked city was chosen. The order is the site search order: match, then priority, then population.

title: Send feedback
